apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: preview-{{BRANCH}}

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: repo-vol-{{BRANCH}}
  namespace: preview-{{BRANCH}}
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  storageClassName: longhorn
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 5Gi

---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: clustergit-backend
  namespace: preview-{{BRANCH}}
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: clustergit-backend
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: clustergit-backend
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: backend
          image: ghcr.io/laurenislearning/clustergit-backend:{{BRANCH}}
          imagePullPolicy: Always
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: clustergit-backend-env
          volumeMounts:
            - mountPath: /git-repos
              name: repo-volume
      volumes:
        - name: repo-volume
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: repo-vol-{{BRANCH}}

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: clustergit-backend
  namespace: preview-{{BRANCH}}
spec:
  selector:
    app: clustergit-backend
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 80

---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: clustergit-preview
  namespace: preview-{{BRANCH}}
  annotations:
    kubernetes.io/ingress.class: traefik
spec:
  ingressClassName: traefik
  rules:
    - host: "{{BRANCH}}.clustergit.com
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: clustergit-backend
                port:
                  number: 80
